mostWorthwhile.text: Making and exporting collagen was the most worthwhile passage: it connected work inside a cell to support outside it, and the picture descriptions traced the route clearly.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new fibers into the rebuilding body was straightforward, though the cross-section clearly showed what remained to be repaired.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the surface could close while deeper collagen remodeling continues.

arbitrary.text: The need to use the repair cell as the partner for processing collagen was not obvious to me; I tried the membranes directly, and compatibility feedback completed the operation.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it explored another process through similarly clear connections between cells and tissues. I was interested in how collagen production led to wound repair.
